_comment: P3 第四批切片金标（docs/P2_COUPLING_ENGINE_2026-10-24.md §6/§8）：GET /api/v1/quotes/{quote_id}（详情）。同目录同脚本用旧路径真实生成；注意旧路径「锁定」查询是 C 类形态：trade_docs 有行就不再查 orders —— 门面按同一条件取数（datasets.trade_docs_locked 为空时才查 orders）。行项时间戳同样覆盖零微秒（id=2 的 created_at）与非零微秒（id=1）。

old_sql.sql: SELECT * FROM quote_orders WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND id=$2 AND (owner_id = $3 OR owner_scope = 'tenant' OR team_id = $4)
SELECT * FROM quote_order_items WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND quote_order_id=$2 ORDER BY sort_order, id
SELECT 1 FROM trade_docs WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND quote_id=$2 AND doc_type <> 'quotation' LIMIT 1
SELECT 1 FROM orders WHERE tenant_id=$1 AND quote_id=$2 LIMIT 1

quote_orders_total.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM quote_orders WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND (owner_id = $2 OR owner_scope = 'tenant' OR team_id = $3)

quote_orders.columns: id, tenant_id, quote_no, customer_id, customer_name, inquiry_id, status, currency, total_amount, CASE WHEN to_char(valid_until AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'US') = '000000' THEN to_char(valid_until AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') ELSE to_char(valid_until AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US') END || '+00:00' AS valid_until, notes, fx_rate, to_char(fx_rate_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS fx_rate_date, tax_archive_id, tax_archive_code, tax_archive_name, tax_snapshot, incoterm, payment_terms, port_of_loading, port_of_destination, shipping_marks, country_of_origin, destination_country, destination_region, carrier, to_char(freight_valid_from, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS freight_valid_from, to_char(freight_valid_to, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS freight_valid_to, created_by, owner_id, owner_scope, team_id, CASE WHEN to_char(created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'US') = '000000' THEN to_char(created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') ELSE to_char(created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US') END || '+00:00' AS created_at, CASE WHEN to_char(updated_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'US') = '000000' THEN to_char(updated_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') ELSE to_char(updated_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US') END || '+00:00' AS updated_at
quote_orders.sql: SELECT id, tenant_id, quote_no, customer_id, customer_name, inquiry_id, status, currency, total_amount, CASE WHEN to_char(valid_until AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'US') = '000000' THEN to_char(valid_until AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') ELSE to_char(valid_until AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US') END || '+00:00' AS valid_until, notes, fx_rate, to_char(fx_rate_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS fx_rate_date, tax_archive_id, tax_archive_code, tax_archive_name, tax_snapshot, incoterm, payment_terms, port_of_loading, port_of_destination, shipping_marks, country_of_origin, destination_country, destination_region, carrier, to_char(freight_valid_from, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS freight_valid_from, to_char(freight_valid_to, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS freight_valid_to, created_by, owner_id, owner_scope, team_id, CASE WHEN to_char(created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'US') = '000000' THEN to_char(created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') ELSE to_char(created_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US') END || '+00:00' AS created_at, CASE WHEN to_char(updated_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'US') = '000000' THEN to_char(updated_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') ELSE to_char(updated_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US') END || '+00:00' AS updated_at FROM quote_orders WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND (owner_id = $2 OR owner_scope = 'tenant' OR team_id = $3) ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT $4 OFFSET $5
